blocks.text: Lana Gomez is an American contemporary artist based in Los Angeles, known for vibrant, large-scale acrylics and energetic mixed-media compositions.
Her work spans private collections, public installations, and collaborations—including serving as resident painter for Kelly Wearstler, featured in Wearstler’s monograph Hue.
Exhibited across New York, Miami, Washington, D.C., and Los Angeles, her work has been featured in The New Yorker, InStyle, and House Beautiful.
Bold color, spontaneous gesture, and contemporary spirit.
Every canvas begins with spontaneous gesture and intuitive color. Layering acrylics, textures, and fluid motion, each piece captures personal memory and raw creative energy.
“Color and form are an invitation to see the world with curiosity and joy.”
Art created to spark emotion, memory, and connection.
Limited editions and bespoke design partnerships uniting contemporary fine art with luxury craft.
Wearable art and modern fine jewelry.
A limited edition of 50 numbered handbags created in partnership with luxury house Pagerie.
Each piece is cut from a single original painting by Lana Gomez, handcrafted in signature grain leather with surgical-grade stainless steel hardware.
Wearable art. No two bags are alike.
A fine jewelry collaboration with SHAY, transforming Lana Gomez’s signature forms into 18k gold, diamond, and emerald jewels.
Modern heirlooms celebrating feminine strength and creative power.
Art driven by spontaneous gesture and vibrant expression.
